definition.title: PoC source acquisition
definition.description: Acquire a bounded public GitHub commit ZIP or explicit loopback fixture; preserve raw evidence and structural inventory without execution.

operations.name: acquire
operations.title: Acquire bounded source
operations.description: Resolve one selected source, preserve raw ZIP bytes, and inventory its structure without extraction.

side_effects.description: Contacts only fixed GitHub API/codeload endpoints for the selected public repository, or an explicitly selected loopback fixture port.
Stages bounded responses in a managed Workspace and spools raw/manifest Artifacts.
